directProbe.recipe: Independent synthetic raw streams, not PR26 fixture copies. BFINAL=1, BTYPE=2, HCLEN=15 (all 19 positions), 74-bit metadata header. Default metadata has symbols 0..15 at length 4 and 16..18 at 0; LL/D lengths emitted directly as 4-bit canonical symbols. Successful body is only canonical EOB; padding is zero. Invalid declarations have no body. Codes-invalid cases stop at the 74-bit metadata declaration.
directProbe.expected: Every valid fixture produces zero bytes and reaches IsFinished with TotalIn=raw length and RemainingInput=0; repeated completion call returns zero. Invalid fixtures throw exact StreamDecodingException/message after consuming at least ceil(declarationBits/8), before completion; no output. EOF, false completion, wrong error, budget or timeout are failures.

bounds.checks: Drain before feeding; input immutability, all three output bytes and cumulative counters checked in finally. Time checked before/after calls, after typed throws and completion stability. External deadline handles nonreturning calls.

coverageLimits: Out-of-range byte lengths are not representable by this raw grammar; range checks receive static inspection, not a false raw coverage claim.
Repeat codes are unchanged and covered by external prior regressions, not this direct recipe.
No raw artifact, log or binary is written by the direct probe.

references.interpretation: Completeness is interpreted from the full binary tree definition. Distance single-bit/unused-empty exceptions are explicit in RFC1951 section3.2.7; EOB-only exception is clearer in puff/reference checks. Empty CODES preconstruction rejection is this policy contract, distinct from reference delayed invalid-sentinel behavior. Default zlib HDIST>30 rejection is not used as the normative oracle.
